latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the 中国卫健委技能 (National Health Commission of China):

- Provides access to national medical policies, health guidelines, and disease prevention information.
- Supports queries on drug management, public health emergencies, and health statistics.
- Includes information for maternal and child health, as well as chronic and infectious disease control.
- Intended for users seeking official health and medical information in China.
